question: is there a hiking or outdoors club at ramapo?
answer:
Yes. The directory lists Hiking Club (Student Organization): https://archway.ramapo.edu/Hiking/ [1]. It offers opportunities to enjoy nature, exercise and visit local county and state parks and reservations for hikes of varying difficulty [2, 9]. Other outdoor-related groups listed on the pages are Rock Climbing Club [4], Ski & Snowboard Club [5], and RCNJ Birding [8]. Garden Club and Bass Fishing Club are marked not currently active as of 6/12/25 [6, 7].

question: what religious or faith based student orgs are there? im catholic but would be open to interfaith stuff too
answer:
The club directory lists nine faith-related organizations [1]. For you as a Catholic, Newman Catholic @ Ramapo is listed as a Student Organization: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Newman/ [5]. Its activities include Sunday and weekday Mass, Eucharistic Adoration, Bible studies, Newman Nights, OCIA classes, service, retreats, Confession, and spiritual direction. It welcomes people wherever they are in their faith journey [16]. For more information, visit https://www.ramaponewman.com/ or email campusministry@ramapo.edu [17]. Newman is open to all Ramapo faculty, staff, and students regardless of religious beliefs [10].

Other directory listings [1]: Muslim Student Association (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/MSA/ [1]; Sikh Student Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/sikh/ [2]; Hillel (Student Organization - Religious, Social), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Hillel/ [3]; Chabad Jewish Student Club (Student Organization), https://chabad5.wixsite.com/chabadrcnj [4]; Trillium (Office Sponsored Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Trillium/ [6]; InterVarsity Christian Fellowship (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/IVCF/ [7]; First Year Fanatics-Orientation Group 4 (Office Sponsored Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/OG4/ [8]; Syriac Orthodox Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Syriac/ [9].

For interfaith exploration, Ramapo’s faith-based organizations offer ways to connect and learn about different traditions; the page names MSA, IVCF, Newman Catholic, Hillel, and Chabad. It also lists an Interfaith Prayer & Reflection Space in H-201 [14]. IVCF says its weekly Bible-study small groups are open to everyone, wherever they are in their faith journey; email ivcf@ramapo.edu to learn more [15].
